editorial:
After their high school basketball coach passes away, five old friends and former teammates reunite for a Fourth of July holiday weekend. You follow Lenny, Eric, Kurt, Marcus, and Rob as they bring their families to a lake house and try to relive their glory days. The vibe is loose, loud, and full of silly jokes, with the guys teasing each other like they never grew up. It feels like hanging out with your own childhood buddies, complete with awkward family moments and plenty of slapstick.

The cast is packed with comedy stars, and their chemistry carries the whole thing. The jokes come fast, though some land better than others, and the story stays light and easy to follow. If you want deep drama, this is not it, but if you want a feel-good laugh with friends, it delivers. Watch it streaming in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for movie night.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, the five friends face off against their old rival team in a basketball game. They lose on purpose to let the younger guys win, showing they have grown up. Afterward, everyone gathers for a big family barbecue, and the friends promise to stay close. The movie ends with them laughing together, proving that friendship matters more than winning.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves buddy comedies and silly family humor.
